description.value: Table: Summon Monster II Creature Subtype(s) Centipede* [(holy/shadow)] Cave Bat* (Avian, [holy/shadow]) Cobra* (Reptilian, [holy/shadow]) Elemental (Minor) (Elemental, Extraplanar) Hedgehog Pie (Daemon, Evil, Extraplanar) Gremlin (Devil, Evil, Extraplanar, Lawful) Imp (Devil, Evil, Extraplanar, Lawful) Tarantula* [(holy/shadow)] Wolf* [(holy/shadow)] Vulture* (Avian, [holy/shadow]) This spell functions like Summon Monster I , except that you can summon one creature from the 2nd-level list with a CR rating of 1 or lower, or 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 1st-level list .
